units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:11">B. Bath. II, 11</cite> <he>בחרוב ובש׳ חמשים אמה</he> when planting a carob tree or a sycamore, (you must keep off from your neighbor’s well) by fifty cubits.
Pes. 53ᵃ, v. שְׁפֵלָה; (Tosef. Shebi. VII, 11 pl.).
<cite ref="Niddah 8b:39">Nidd. 8ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>בתולת ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01383"><he>בְּתוּלָה</he></cite>.

Gen. R. s. 12 (ref. to Is. LXV, 22) כש׳ הזו שהיא וכ׳ like the sycamore that remains in the ground six hundred years; (Pesik. R. s. 1 עץ הסדן); a. fr.—ש׳(של) סדן, v. סַדָּן.—בנות ש׳, v. בַּת I.—Pl. שִׁקְמִים, שִׁקְמִין.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:11">Tosef. Shebi. VII, 11</cite>, v. supra; Y. ib. IX, 38ᵈ bot.; a. e.
